part_canvas_semantics: Logical part registration; whole-leg source textures retain their original larger resolution.
identity: white-lilac bob, violet eyes, cream shirt, brown leather, warm metal

upper_body.render_method: one continuous Polygon2D texture with Skeleton2D skin weights

legs.render_method: One whole-leg Polygon2D texture with thigh and shin Bone2D weights
legs.source_policy: Exact uploaded RGBA subrect; no redraw, palette conversion or thigh/shin split

boots.anchor_authority: Each direction's boot manifest records cuff, ankle and sole contact.

assembly_status: Arcana native world and independent authoring use the same approved bundle
rules: Select assets by direction name; input sheet orders differ.
Keep the slender three-head proportion when registering final parts.
Use per-part physical scale and anchors, never normalize every PNG to its 48x48 transparent canvas.
Arms and torso remain one upper-body image.
Thigh and shin remain one whole-leg image; only bones and weights distinguish them.
Final waist assembly shows the pelvis belt once.
Instantiate one independent boot at each ankle; do not use a two-foot image on one bone.
Source PNGs already contain their one-pixel outline; do not add another outline when displaying them.
Indexed art keeps editable PixelPen originals; whole legs retain the uploaded full-color PNG and native Polygon2D UV/weights.
